node.title: AQB amortization threshold accounting
node.statement: Any c=2 averaged quotient-box family whose certified shared entropy gain after all box charges and normalizations is at least 429,645,547 bits clears the finite AQB deficit at sigma*, because aqb_deficit_arithmetic proves the worst-case deficit is strictly below that threshold by more than 0.226 bits.
node.falsifier: a certified recomputation where the AQB deficit reaches or exceeds 429,645,547 bits
